title: Círculo Femina
author: Circulo Femina
description: CIRCULO FÉMINA is inspired by the African tradition of the “Circle of Women” where the main objective is to create a network of women who help others through exchange.. Exchanging experiences of Latina Female around the world, forming a support network within the participants, enhancing the value of feminine energy by touching transcendental issues in the development of a woman's life. We are going to create some episodes on Spanish and English lenguajes. Depending the subjects and the language of our guests. Flow us on social media and Telegram @Circulo Fermina First episode: 03/08/2021
